source_title: Is Etsy Still Worth It In 2026
snippet_primary: "The rise of AI tools made it incredibly easy to generate designs, write product descriptions, and spin up listings at a pace that was simply not possible before. That sounds great on the surface, right? Faster creation, more listings, more opportunities to be found. The problem is that ease of creation applies to everyone equally. So now you have an enormous volume of shops listing products at a rate the market has never seen before."
